title: 3.2.0.1/2 Loop Calculation Stopped Working
symptom: Loop calculation stopped working at just before 4:00 this morning. BG on main screen and xDrip tab but not on calculation tab. Graphs in History page. Rebooted phone, aaps, un/selected profile, pump, xDrip no luck.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. MilosKozak suggested 'Probably bad data in database' but user reset database and still had problem. User later speculated about plugin tab index mismatch but not confirmed.
fix: User reports that after selecting Open Humans plugin and importing preferences, loop calculation started. However, this is not confirmed as a definitive fix and may be coincidental. No official resolution stated.
evidence_quote: Once I selected this (view was ticked and not altered) and then imported my preferences (over existing) to get back how I was the loop calculation started!
